% function to read the data, returns triangulated facets and edges
\begin{luacode*}
local ld = luadraw
local pt3d = ld.pt3d
local M = pt3d.M
function ld.read_table(data,options)
    options= options or {}
    local nbdiv = options.nbdiv or 10
    local x, y, z = options.x or 1, options.y or 2, options.z or 3
    local scale= options.scale or 1
    local vertices = {}
    local index = 1
    for _ = 1, nbdiv do
        local lg = {}
        for _ = 1, nbdiv do
            table.insert(lg, M(data[index][x], data[index][y], scale*data[index][z]) )
            index = index+1
        end
        table.insert(vertices, lg)
    end
    local facets, edges = {}, {}
    for k = 1, nbdiv-1 do --construction of facets with triangulation
        for j = 1, nbdiv-1 do
            local a, b, c, d = vertices[k][j], vertices[k+1][j], vertices[k+1][j+1], vertices[k][j+1]
            if pt3d.abs(d-b) < pt3d.abs(c-a) then
                table.insert(facets,{a,b,d}); table.insert(facets,{b,c,d})
            else
                table.insert(facets,{a,b,c}); table.insert(facets,{a,c,d})
            end
            table.insert(edges, {a,b,c,d})
        end
    end
    return facets, edges
end
\end{luacode*}

\begin{document}

\begin{luadraw}{name=read_data}
local ld = luadraw
local pt3d = ld.pt3d
local M = pt3d.M
local g = ld.graph3d:new{window3d={-5,5,-5,5,0,2}, adjust2d=true, 
    size={12,8,0}, viewdir={250,75}, bg="lightgray", bbox=false}
g:Labelsize("footnotesize")
local data = ld.read_csv_file("data.csv", {header=false, sep=" "})
local S1, edges1 = ld.read_table(data,{nbdiv=11})
local S2, edges2 = ld.read_table(data, {z=4, nbdiv=11})

local wall = {} --partitioning with planes x=k and y=k
for k = -4,4 do 
    table.insert(wall,{M(k,0,0),M(1,0,0)})
    table.insert(wall,{M(0,k,0),M(0,1,0)})
end
-- drawing
g:Dboxaxes3d({grid=true, gridcolor="gray", fillcolor="white", zstep=0.5})
g:Dscene3d( 
    g:addWall(wall),
    g:addFacet( S1, {color="cyan",contrast=0.25, opacity=0.8}),
    g:addFacet( S2, {color="red",contrast=0.25, opacity=0.8}),
    g:addPolyline( ld.concat(edges1,edges2), {width=2})
    )
g:Show()
\end{luadraw}
